transport: MPPT Control: plugs into the charge controller's VE.Direct port and consumes it. SmartSolar Pluggable Display: seats into the display slot on the front of a SmartSolar MPPT. Neither offers a data port outward.
refutedOnReview: REFUTED — the dialect should be dissolved, not downgraded.  Source verification: both citations are real. The PDF at https://www.victronenergy.com/upload/documents/MPPT_Control_Display/MPPT_Control_display_manual-en.pdf downloads (1.6 MB, 17 pages, PDF title "MPPT Control display manual", "Rev 00 04/2021" — matches the citation). gotchas: The MPPT Control OCCUPIES the charge controller's single VE.Direct port. With one fitted, that MPPT cannot also be cabled to a GX or to a VE.Direct-USB adapter. This is the one fact about it that changes a system design, and it is the reason it is recorded rather than ignored.

The SmartSolar Pluggable Display uses the MPPT's front display slot rather than the VE.Direct port, so it does not have the same conflict — but I found no vendor statement confirming that explicitly during this pass, so treat the distinction as unconfirmed.
Neither listing at the surveyed Quebec retailers states any protocol, and the vendor manuals describe them as displays. Nothing to build.
